projectMove.title: A+ Academy: Give Miyuki a yes or no on two waiting updates
projectMove.body: Two A+ Academy updates are finished and waiting on you. The newer one rewrites 131 weak wrong-answer explanations in the Core 1 networking section so each one names the mistake and the right fact, and every check passed. The older one, open since October 1, adds a Continue button on the start page that reopens your last lesson. A quick yes on each lets Miyuki publish them before cruise prep takes over your week.

tip.title: Turn tonight's Spanish block into port practice
tip.body: Use part of the two-hour Spanish session on lines you will say ashore, like asking a price, ordering food, and asking where something is. Say each one out loud a few times, because hearing your own voice makes them come out easier in a loud port.

surprise.title: ¿Cuánto cuesta? — cruise Spanish for tonight
surprise.body: Your calendar has Spanish from 6 to 8 this evening, and the ship is eighteen days out, so here is a phrase you will actually use in port: ¿Cuánto cuesta? (How much does it cost?). Tap play for a Latin American Spanish pronunciation of cuánto, the word that opens the question.
